name: rto-risk-agent
description: Autonomous RTO risk-scoring agent — explainable ML, guardrailed decisions, and COD-to-prepaid payment conversion tracking. Built for Razorpay AI Buildathon (Track 3: AI Risk Manager).

paragraphs: An autonomous agent that scores incoming orders for RTO risk (Return-to-Origin — a customer refusing delivery or a COD order bouncing back before it's ever accepted) before dispatch, explains its reasoning, and recommends a bounded, guardrailed action. For high-risk COD orders specifically, the agent nudges the customer toward prepaid — converting a risky, unconfirmed COD order into a confirmed payment transaction, instead of shipping blind and eating the reverse-logistics cost after the fact.
Every COD order successfully nudged to prepaid isn't just an RTO prevented — it's a payment that becomes a confirmed transaction instead of a maybe.

Scope note: This agent targets RTO specifically — orders that bounce back before the customer ever receives them (doorstep refusal, COD non-acceptance, failed delivery attempts). It does not address post-delivery returns (a customer receiving a product, trying it, and returning it for size/fit/quality reasons) — those need a different intervention (better size guidance, exchange-first policy) that happens after delivery, not before dispatch.
